programme.name: Product Card 02
programme.sequenceRule: Lock one website-native card architecture and its bounded visual treatments before implementing the functional component family.

supersedes.reason: Rejected as an under-designed generic chassis.
Superseded because function was attempted before the visual architecture was locked.
Rejected because ten isolated art-card treatments obscured the actual website component, included unexplained concepts and presented groupings weakly.

designThesis: A Mez product card is a narrow portrait website component with a stable information spine and one variable product-expression region. Phase A compares only credible treatments of that shared architecture inside real website placements; Phase B then derives the complete responsive discovery, feature, pricing, checkout, bundle and upsell component family.

cardArchitecture.name: Portrait Product Frame
cardArchitecture.familyRule: Comparable sibling products retain equal width, height, alignment and source order.

agentRecommendation.reason: It is the most credible everyday website card: narrow enough to feel like a product object, restrained enough for a family shelf, and structured enough to support the functional variants that follow.

specialModes.use: one earned focal feature or launch placement
dense catalogue, comparison or application surface
commerce or launch media where tangibility improves the offer

visualTreatments.name: Editorial Portrait
visualTreatments.thesis: A quiet body and contained product window create the repeatable everyday website card.

visualTreatments.name: Full Field Portrait
visualTreatments.thesis: The useful full-field expression becomes a narrower feature card with one bounded motion allowance.

visualTreatments.name: System Index
visualTreatments.thesis: Operational metadata and compact product identity support catalogue and comparison without decorative effects.

visualTreatments.name: Product Pack
visualTreatments.thesis: A tactile package makes a digital system feel owned at a commerce or launch moment without becoming the universal card shell.

surfaceStrategy.calmShelf: Use a white raised card on the canonical F8 canvas.
surfaceStrategy.focalContrast: Use charcoal on a light field or white on a charcoal room when one component must lead.
surfaceStrategy.darkIntegration: Use canonical dark room #171715, recessed #1B1B19 and raised #252523 instead of pure black.
surfaceStrategy.rule: Surface contrast follows component role; it is not a global recolour toggle.

groupingComponents.name: Family Shelf
groupingComponents.meaning: Separate peer products presented for comparison with equal card geometry.

groupingComponents.name: Bundle Offer
groupingComponents.meaning: One commercial package owns the hierarchy and included products become supporting rows rather than competing cards.

liveAllowed: one C02 Full Field Portrait in a focal feature placement
coreAllocation.fallback: exact static twin without layout shift

phaseBScope.startsAfter: H-EXP-04A-CARD-VISUAL-DIRECTION approves the architecture and treatment allocation

accessibility.selection: Selected treatment uses text and outline, not colour alone.
accessibility.focus: Canonical three-pixel focus ring with three-pixel offset.
accessibility.motion: Reduced motion and renderer failure use the exact static twin.
accessibility.sourceOrder: Mobile compositions preserve the desktop information order.
